reviews.snippet: Shonique was rude. I asked if I could use a reward I obtained from the smashburger app, and she said no which is fine, but proceeds to tell me that the cheapest burger they have is the classic smash. Assuming a customer will not want other (more expensive) options when unable to use a reward is extremely rude.  I then proceed to stand in an open space to which she calls me back and tell me that I am obstructing the way for the other employee to walk pass. That's something someone else could have told me when they needed me to move. I plan on not coming to this store again. Also, a cup for water is $2.29, because they also charge for tap.
